thread:
Maya: quick follow-up from the PM postmortem. We need owners and deadlines for tests/evals driven by the recent eviction pattern. Short list: regression harness, incident-derived promptset, staging burst load, and a scoped chaos drill.
Tom: i'll take the regression harness and PR gating. plan: small fast checks on PR + full nightly run. ETA 2025-04-05.
Rina: i'll curate the promptset from the traces and tag cases by mode (truncated prefix, kv-miss cascade, memory pressure). aiming for ~20 samples with golden outputs. ETA 2025-04-09.
Omar: i'll own the staging load profiles and the first chaos drill. proposal: weekly spike job (Tue 02:00 UTC) and a monthly controlled failover test. need runbook + rollback commands. ETA infra-as-code 2025-04-12.
Maya: nice. i'll create tracker tickets and link them to the remediation board. we also want an "incident-pattern watch" digest that clusters similar incidents and creates triage items once a threshold is hit.
Tom: gating preference: tests tag severity (critical/high/medium). critical/high block release, medium advisory. i'll add severity metadata to each test.
Rina: for evals, i'll include perf + quality checks (p95, token-loss, overlap). also adding minimal repro scripts to speed debug.
CI-Bot: ticket INF-7301 created: "Eviction regression harness (PR+nightly)" -> Tom, due 2025-04-05.
CI-Bot: ticket INF-7302 created: "Eviction promptset & evals" -> Rina, due 2025-04-09.
CI-Bot: ticket INF-7303 created: "Staging burst load & chaos drill" -> Omar, due 2025-04-12.
Omar: chaos checklist i'll draft: preflight health, canary fallback mapping, abort/rollback cmds, pager list, metric thresholds. will post before infra PR.
Tom: detector idea: eviction_rate > 4% AND p95_latency > 2x => add a digest row. i'll prototype a detector rule and hook it to the digest.
Maya: good. digest should create a "pattern-watch" ticket when >=3 similar incidents in 14 days. ops-sre to triage and optionally spin up remediation sprint.
Rina: i'll label prompts with severity and add to the evals dashboard. also adding synthetic edge cases that reproduce misaligned KV fetches.
Maya: scheduling a 25m sync on 2025-03-31 14:00 UTC to review PRs and the promptset. invite owners. please update tickets with blockers. :thumbsup:
CI-Bot: calendar event created: "Pattern-watch: eviction tests check-in" 2025-03-31 14:00 UTC.
Tom: i'll standardize job names to releases/eviction/{pr,nightly} so history aggregates cleanly.
Omar: noted on blast radius. we'll run canary fallback tests first, then a more aggressive cutover in later drills.
Maya: great. thanks all. keep updates on the tickets and drop any digest output into #eng-sre.
